result.Method of Attack: Typosquatting by cloning a legitimate package (certifi), changing only the distribution name to 'certify' while keeping the internal import package name 'certifi' intact to deceive users
result.Impacted Systems: Python development environments using PyPI packages
result.Attack Vector: Publishing a malicious package with a similar name to a popular package on PyPI to trick developers into installing it
result.Indicators of Compromise: Package distribution name 'certify' differs from import package name 'certifi'; Presence of certify-2024.2.2.tar.gz and certify-2024.2.2-py3-none-any.whl; ModuleNotFoundError when importing 'certify' but successful import of 'certifi' after installing 'certify' package
